description:
WHAT: Wire jmap-chat-client Cargo.toml to use jmap-base-client, and make two approved changes to jmap-base-client.

ALGORITHM:
1. crate-jmap-chat-client/Cargo.toml:
   - Add: jmap-base-client = { path = "../crate-jmap-base-client" }
   - Add: ulid = "1"
   - Add: chrono = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["std", "clock"] }
   - Keep: jmap-types, jmap-chat-types, serde, serde_json, thiserror, tokio
   - Remove: reqwest, tokio-tungstenite, url (now transitive via jmap-base-client)
   - Verify: cargo check -p jmap-chat-client compiles after changes

2. crate-jmap-base-client/src/sse.rs — add raw data to Unknown variant:
   Change: SseEvent::Unknown { event_type: String }
   To: SseEvent::Unknown { event_type: String, data: String }
   - Update parse_sse_block to capture the data: line into the new field
   - Update all match arms that destructure Unknown to use { event_type, .. }
   - Run existing tests to verify no regressions

3. crate-jmap-base-client/src/ws/mod.rs — add raw JSON to Unknown variant:
   Change: WsFrame::Unknown { type_name: String }
   To: WsFrame::Unknown { type_name: String, raw: serde_json::Value }
   - Update parse_ws_frame to deserialize the full JSON object and include raw
   - Update all match arms that destructure Unknown
   - Run existing tests

4. crate-jmap-base-client/src/error.rs — add RateLimited variant:
   Add to ClientError enum: RateLimited { retry_after: jmap_types::UTCDate }
   - Ensure Display impl covers it
   - Run existing tests

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- jmap-base-client changes: ONLY the listed variants and function — do not touch any other public API, type, or test
- All existing tests in jmap-base-client must pass unchanged
- #[non_exhaustive] means all match arms on ClientError/SseEvent/WsFrame already need wildcards — adding variants does not break existing code

ACCEPTANCE: cargo check --workspace passes; cargo test --workspace passes; cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
title: Cargo.toml wiring + jmap-base-client unlock (raw SSE/WS, RateLimited)
